## Self-rated health overview

```{python}
#| echo: false
order  = srh["order"]
totals = {r["self_rated_health"]: r["pct"] for r in srh["overall"]}
pcts   = [totals.get(h, 0) for h in order]
colors = COLORS["health_scale"]

fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
    x=order, y=pcts,
    marker_color=colors,
    text=[f"{p}%" for p in pcts],
    textposition="outside",
    hovertemplate="%{x}: %{y}%<extra></extra>",
))
fig.update_layout(yaxis_title="% of respondents", xaxis_title="Self-rated health")
fig = fig_defaults(fig, title="How do Canadians rate their own health?", height=380)
fig.show()
```

::: {.stat-callout}
**`{python} totals.get("Excellent", 0) + totals.get("Very good", 0)`%** of respondents
rate their health as *Excellent* or *Very good*.
:::

---

## Chronic condition burden

```{python}
#| echo: false
cond_data = sorted(chron["overall"], key=lambda r: r["prevalence"], reverse=True)
labels = [r["condition"] for r in cond_data]
vals   = [r["prevalence"] for r in cond_data]

fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
    x=vals, y=labels,
    orientation="h",
    marker_color=COLORS["primary"],
    text=[f"{v}%" for v in vals],
    textposition="outside",
    hovertemplate="%{y}: %{x}%<extra></extra>",
))
fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_title="Prevalence (%)",
    yaxis=dict(autorange="reversed"),
)
fig = fig_defaults(fig, title="Prevalence of Chronic Conditions", height=400)
fig.show()
```
